summary.text: NO-GO: expressed not met (0.5814 TPM in Small_Intestine_Terminal_Ileum, the run's chosen tissue, a disease tissue for this contrast), dysregulated in the study met (logFC 2.9, adjusted p 1.04e-17), and phenotype in a study met (phenotyped, 6 abnormal terms on record). Hypothesis: inhibition, because the gene is up-regulated in the Crohn's disease versus non-inflammatory-bowel-disease control contrast, logFC 2.9, adjusted p 1.04e-17. Mouse knockouts show increased susceptibility to bacterial infection, abnormal dendritic cell antigen presentation, abnormal type I hypersensitivity reaction, decreased susceptibility to induced arthritis, abnormal macrophage physiology and decreased susceptibility to autoimmune haemolytic anaemia, while tissue expression stands at 0.5814 TPM in the terminal ileum. The pipeline holds 1 agent, MDX-447, furthest stage Phase 1 in glioblastoma, with 0 live trials; development level: an approved drug acts on it, 2 ChEMBL mechanisms, and 13,724 PubTator3 records. The change may reflect infiltrating immune cells rather than regulation in the tissue: whole blood 32.12 TPM and spleen 6.247 TPM are both at or above the region's 0.5814 TPM. No data: chemical probe and regional specificity; the clinical-phase ring is not applicable, since no candidate is indicated for a disease attributable to this target.
